searchText: I am reading this for the first time. I know there is now a sudden rush to get the merge done ASAP and even drop certain pieces of the roadmap to get there. This article for me was like taking the red pill in the matrix and my eyes have been opened. This part in particular would make perfect sense why we need to hurry up and merge before the SEC makes a decision. https://coingeek.com/ethereum-2-0-is-an-unexploded-regulatory-bomb/ quick question to anyone who knows, if BSC keeps increasing their block gas ceiling how much disk space are we talking, can they scale it forever or will there be some limitation they will hit? ignoring the centralized nature of it, just found this and they are already looking to increase it: https://github.com/binance-chain/BEPs/pull/101 barely matters, binance can afford the storage and ram :p > This part in particular would make perfect sense why we need to hurry up and merge before the SEC makes a decision. Na sry It depends on who their target audience for running a validating client is primarily, along with how much usage they get and the type of usage they receive.
